errors.evidence: The tick marks on the y-axis are at -25%, -15%, -5%, 0%, and 5%. The intervals are not uniform at 5% but are 10%, 10%, 5%, and 5% respectively.

errors.text_span: then rises to about 0% in Layer13-20

errors.text_span: and gradually increases to roughly 2% in Layer29-32
errors.evidence: The yellow line does not increase to 2% at Layer29-32; its final value is just below 0%.
The red line recovers to approximately -1% at Layer29-32, not 0%.
The light blue line drops to approximately -3% at Layer5-12, not -5%.
The light blue line drops to approximately -12% at Layer13-20, not -15%.
The light blue line rises back to approximately -2% at Layer29-32, not -5%.
In the description of the dark blue line, it states it begins at -5%, but it actually begins at approximately -2.5% at Layer1-4.
The dark blue line decreases to approximately -4% at Layer5-12, not -10%.
The dark blue line increases to approximately -3.5% at Layer29-32, not -10%.
